text: 10.03 Supply of SCOMET Items from DTA to SEZ/Eo U and outside the country No export authorisation is required for supply of SCOMET items from DTA to SEZ/EOU. Export Authorisation is, however, required if the SCOMET items are to be physically exported outside the country from SEZ/EOU, i.e. to another country (Refer Rule 26 of the SEZ Rules, 2006). All supplies of SCOMET items from DTA to SEZ/EOU will be reported to the Development Commissioner (DC) of the respective SEZ/Eo U by the supplier in the prescribed proforma [Annexure 1 to Appendix-3 to Schedule 2 of ITC (HS) Classifications of Export and Import Items] within one week of the supplies getting effected. An annual report of such supplies from DTA to SEZ/EOU shall be reported to DGFT (Hqrs), by the DC of SEZ/EOU in the prescribed proforma [Annexure 2 to Appendix-3] by 15th May of every financial year, in respect of supplies from DTA to SEZ/EOU during the preceding financial year.
